title: Exploit More, Explore Smarter for Budget-Constrained Agentic Search
abstract: arXiv:2608.23848v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Budget-constrained agentic search arises when an LLM agent must refine candidates under a small evaluation budget, because validation is expensive, generation requires multiple model calls, or both. In this regime, standard MCTS allocates budget poorly: exploration bonuses dominate at low visit counts, unpromising siblings are expanded before promising chains can deepen, and branching is independent of node quality. We introduce ExTS, a tree-search policy that treats expansion itself as a value-of-information decision. ExTS combines three mechanisms: discriminative reward shaping to separate candidates under narrow score distributions, a stochastic virtual child that estimates the value of creating a new branch from the parent's reward history, and quality-conditioned branching that expands only when a node's score justifies the budget cost. Across prompt optimization, code generation, molecular structure elucidation, and agentic workflo

translated_title: 在预算受限的代理搜索中，更充分地利用，更聪明地探索
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23848v1 公告类型：新 摘要：预算受限的代理搜索出现在当LLM代理必须在小型评估预算下优化候选方案时，因为验证成本高昂、生成需要多次模型调用，或两者兼有。在这种模式下，标准MCTS对预算的分配效果不佳：探索奖励在低访问次数时占主导，无望的兄弟节点在有望链加深之前被扩展，且分支与节点质量无关。我们引入了ExTS，一种将扩展本身视为信息价值决策的树搜索策略。ExTS结合了三种机制：判别性奖励塑形，以在狭窄的得分分布中分离候选方案；一个随机虚拟子节点，通过父节点的奖励历史估计创建新分支的价值；以及质量条件分支，仅当节点的得分证明预算成本合理时才进行扩展。在提示优化、代码生成、分子结构解析和代理工作流等任务中，ExTS在相同或更低的预算下显著优于现有方法，在多个基准上实现了最高达18%的性能提升。
tldr: ExTS通过将树搜索中的扩展决策视为信息价值判断，结合奖励塑形、虚拟子节点估计和质量条件分支，在预算受限的代理搜索中大幅提升性能。
en_tdlr: ExTS treats expansion as a value-of-information decision, combining reward shaping, virtual child estimation, and quality-conditioned branching to significantly boost performance in budget-constrained agentic search.
